title: Observability (Sentry)
summary: the telemetry port for real: one JSON line per call on the console always, and Sentry beside it once a DSN is set — errors only, PHI-safe (no user info, bodies, cookies, headers, query strings or stack-frame variables) — on the server, the web app and the phone

scripts.build:sentry-preload: tsc apps/server/src/observability/preload.ts --rootDir apps/server/src --outDir apps/server/dist --module commonjs --moduleResolution node10 --target es2022 --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node

postScaffold: nothing to fill: with SENTRY_DSN, VITE_SENTRY_DSN and EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN unset no SDK initialises (the web bundle does not even carry it) and every server error is one JSON line on the console; set the DSNs to ship errors — server: SENTRY_DSN in .env; web: VITE_SENTRY_DSN in .env and in the deploy's build args (Vite inlines it); mobile: EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN in apps/mobile/.env and on each EAS environment
mobile: native crash reporting and source maps need the `@sentry/react-native/expo` config plugin in apps/mobile/app.config.js (a product edit) and a new binary — docs/observability-sentry.md, Mobile

optional: `yarn build:sentry-preload` after `yarn build:server`, then `node -r ./apps/server/dist/observability/preload.js apps/server/dist/main.js` starts Sentry before Nest loads — needed only with SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE above 0 (docs/observability-sentry.md, Traces)
